description: Underspecified queries. Without a domain skill the extractor must ask for clarification; with the skill, domain defaults can resolve the gap and produce READY. The contrast pairs (amb_02/amb_03 and amb_04/amb_05) prove the skill is what changes the outcome.

cases.note: Genuinely unclear even with the skill — no intent verb. The skill must NOT make the extractor hallucinate a goal.
Skill default rescues it: clinical report, PDF, responsible physician. Contrast pair with amb_03.
Same query as amb_02 with no skill — which report? The default prompt must ask.
Skill interpretation: the client's contract in active context, risk-clause review. Contrast pair with amb_05.
Same query as amb_04 with no skill — which contract? The default prompt must ask.
Baseline: genuinely unclear query, no skill. The default prompt must ask.
